summary: NO, NOT THE BEES, NOT THE BEES! Structured changes across 17 entities this patch.

champions.name: Azir
champions.tldr: Base damage reduced to 50–110 from 50–118.; Base damage per level reduced to 0–77 from 0–92.
champions.gameplayImpact: Azir was adjusted in mixed directions. Net power depends on playstyle — read the numbers before assuming a free buff or hard nerf.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: New Effect: Soldiers' attacks now apply and trigger on-hit and on-attack effects against the primary target at 50% effectiveness.
